descriptionInUI: EWR sites cue nearby fighter flights (BARCAP, TARCAP, Fighter sweep) onto air contacts they hold on radar. Detection range, terrain masking and the radar horizon come from the engine's own radar model, so a contact hidden by terrain or flying low is not reported. Runs for BOTH coalitions, so it does not favour one side. Cued flights are given a bounded intercept task and return to their planned route when it expires. Prototype.

specificOptions.nameInUI: Observe only (report what it would do, never task anything)
